description: ClassBridge Domain Adaptation Layer Glossary - Curated canonical technical translations for Tamil, Malayalam, and Hindi.

eigenvalue.definition: A scalar associated with a linear system of equations measuring factor expansion along an eigenvector.

eigenvector.definition: A non-zero vector whose direction remains unchanged when a linear transformation is applied.

gradient descent.definition: First-order iterative optimization algorithm for finding a local minimum of a differentiable function.

backpropagation.definition: Algorithm used to calculate gradients of loss function with respect to weights using chain rule.

neural network.definition: A computational model inspired by biological nervous systems consisting of interconnected layers.

loss function.definition: Function that maps values onto a real number representing cost or discrepancy.

learning rate.definition: Tuning parameter in optimization determining the step size at each iteration.

overfitting.definition: Modeling error where a function corresponds too closely or exactly to a particular set of data.

underfitting.definition: When a mathematical model cannot adequately capture the underlying structure of the data.

activation function.definition: Node function that defines output given inputs, introducing non-linearity.

photosynthesis.definition: Process by which phototrophs convert light energy into chemical energy.

mitochondria.definition: Double-membrane-bound cellular organelle that produces adenosine triphosphate (ATP).

cellular respiration.definition: Metabolic reactions converting biochemical energy from nutrients into ATP.

thermodynamics.definition: Branch of physics dealing with heat, work, temperature, and statistical relation to energy.

entropy.definition: Scientific concept associated with state of disorder, randomness, or uncertainty.

momentum.definition: The quantity of motion of a moving body, measured as mass times velocity.

kinetic energy.definition: The energy an object possesses by reason of its motion, equal to 1/2 m v^2.

potential energy.definition: Stored energy held by an object because of its relative position.

matrix multiplication.definition: Binary operation that produces a matrix from two matrices with compatible dimensions.

determinant.definition: Scalar value computed from elements of a square matrix encoding transformation properties.

derivative.definition: The rate of change of a function with respect to an independent variable.

integral.definition: Mathematical concept assigning numbers to functions representing area, volume, displacement.

asymptotic notation.definition: Mathematical notations describing limiting behavior of execution complexity.

time complexity.definition: Computational complexity describing computer time taken to run an algorithm.

binary search.definition: Search algorithm that finds target position in a sorted array in O(log n) time.

stochastic gradient descent.definition: Iterative optimization technique that calculates gradient on random mini-batches.
